name: n8n
description: Fair-code workflow automation platform with native AI capabilities. Combine visual building with custom code, self-host or cloud, 400+ integrations.
one_liner: A drag-and-drop tool for connecting different apps and automating repetitive business tasks, with built-in AI steps.
buyer: A small business owner drowning in manual admin work (invoices, lead follow-up, data entry between apps) who can't afford custom software.
business_use_cases: A real estate agency automates lead intake from their website form straight into their CRM and triggers a personalized follow-up email.
An e-commerce store automates order-to-fulfillment workflows across Shopify, a spreadsheet, and a shipping provider.
A consultant builds and sells custom n8n automation workflows to small businesses as a service.

money_ideas.idea: Offer 'automation audits' for small businesses: identify 3 manual workflows and build n8n automations for a flat fee.
Run a monthly retainer maintaining and expanding a client's automations as their business changes.

steal_this: Pick one local business, interview them about their most annoying manual task, and build + deliver a working n8n automation for it this weekend for a flat fee.
